newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albanian president approves new interim government.
newsitem.headline: Albanian president approves new interim government.

text.p: Albanian President Sali Berisha on Wednesday approved an interim broad-based government charged with trying to end an armed rebellion in the south and organising new elections by June.
A decree broadcast on state television said Berisha had accepted the 15-member government chosen by Prime Minister Bashkim Fino, a member of the opposition Socialists appointed on Tuesday.

Berisha and opposition parties reached a deal last weekend for the creation of a national unity government, new elections and an amnesty for rebels who have seized most of the south to hand in their weapons.
Nine of the 10 parties originally involved in the negotiations are represented in the new government.
One party, the Democratic Alliance, pulled out of the negotiations after the key post of Interior Minister, which they wanted to be held by the opposition, went to Berisha's ruling Democratic Party.

The ministry is responsible for local councils and the police, regarded as crucial for organising new elections. The last elections in 1995 were criticised as seriously flawed by international observers and boycotted by the opposition.
